description:
A THEORY IS A SOLUTION SHAPE YOU TRY TO PRODUCE, and its residual is the work remaining. THEORY_AS_SHAPE_RESULTS.md established that a target shape decodes against the held codebook like any other grain -- the residual is exactly the part of the wanted state not yet reachable from what the agent has. What it also established is that MINTING that residual is wrong: it turns 'my theory needs radar' into 'radar is a held capability', reporting covered and residual [] while nothing was built and nothing learned.

The asymmetry is exact. At the OBSERVATION grain a residual is EVIDENCE -- the world supplied something the codebook could not explain, so minting a quantum is warranted. At the TARGET grain a residual is a DEMAND: nothing supplied it, and minting would assert a capability on the strength of wanting one. So a target-grain residual OPENS A CONCERN rather than closing itself, and the concern closes only when the residual genuinely empties -- which requires something to have actually produced the part.

rules.name: tr_decode_theory
rules.comment: Decode the theory's OWN held shape against the codebook. Epoch-gated on the same `codebook_epoch` idiom the sd loop uses, so the decode re-arms whenever the codebook grows -- which is what lets a concern close later without anything re-authoring the theory.

rules.name: tr_open_concern
rules.comment:
A NON-EMPTY RESIDUAL OPENS A CONCERN. It does NOT mint the missing part -- that would be wishful thinking, and the loop would report success having built nothing. The concern enters the same human-gated spine every other SelfConcern uses (promote -> StandingConcern -> experiment -> adopt), so the only route from 'wanted' to 'held' runs through evidence.

Deduped by content against every live SelfConcern, matching gap_awareness's own guard, so one gap is filed once however many times the decode re-arms.

rules.name: tr_resolve_concern
rules.comment: THE ONLY WAY THE CONCERN CLOSES. When the theory's residual has genuinely emptied -- because the codebook gained the part by some route that had to supply evidence -- the concern it opened is marked resolved. Nothing here can empty a residual; this rule only observes that it has emptied. That asymmetry is the whole point of the seed.
